0000.png.text: Software quality is not one step at the end of a sprint. It is decided in hundreds of small moments: when a bug is diagnosed, when code is reviewed, when a test is written, and when something breaks in production.

chunks.text: Software quality is not one step at the
end of a sprint.
It is decided in hundreds of small moments:
when a bug is diagnosed,
when code is reviewed,
when a test is written,
and when something breaks in production.

0001.png.text: Devin, from Cognition, takes part in every one of those moments. Not as a linter that flags problems, but as an engineer that investigates them, fixes them, proves the fix, and hands the result back to your team.

0002.png.text: In this video we follow one product through the whole loop. Fairshare is a small expense-splitting app, with a TypeScript API, a web dashboard, and an iOS app.
